process: SKY130 published basic RCX table values
source_note: Table 91 resistance; Table 93 downward fringe; Table 95 parallel area. Documented fringe values are approximations from 5 um x 10 um test plates, not a calibrated general geometry model.
scope_limitations: Constant-width, non-self-intersecting Manhattan centerline model with a large quiet met2 reference plane.
Lower capacitance uses area plus a constant fringe-perimeter approximation; upper coupling and grounded-patch capacitance use overlap area only.

Upper edge/fringing fields, same-layer lateral coupling, shielding redistribution, floating fill, vias, pin/device capacitance, width corrections, process corners, temperature, package and substrate networks are omitted.
The 20 kohm driver/bias resistance, 50 fF receiver load, 1.8 V stimulus, geometry, and accuracy target are teaching assumptions.
SVG layouts illustrate the input geometry; they are not DRC/LVS-clean GDS or output from a foundry-qualified extraction deck.
ngspice solves the generated linear RC network; it does not validate the geometry estimator or turn its results into foundry extraction.
